summary: Define neutral licensed reputation status observations
description: Define a source-neutral contract that maps authorized aggregate source statuses such as spam or phishing into existing calibrated CallerSignal risk states while keeping safe, verified organisation, and insufficient-evidence semantics distinct.
acceptance: Authorized source observations can express bounded aggregate categories including spam, phishing, scam, telemarketing, robocall, nuisance, and no-current-risk-match with source-native value, sample basis, freshness, confidence, and provenance.

Phishing or scam never identifies a caller or subscriber; safe is not a stored verdict; no-current-risk-match can only produce no_risk_evidence after a current eligible risk-capable source check; verified remains an organisation declaration rather than call-origin proof.
Unknown, conflicting, stale, single-unverified, and unsupported source values fail closed under the existing four-state risk contract.
